newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end bourse trade strongly ahead.
newsitem.headline: German shares end bourse trade strongly ahead.

text.p: 1136 GMT - Germany's DAX index ends bourse session up 2.23 percent, tracking IBIS computer trading gains tied to overnight Wall Street gains and firmer dollar. Dealers see little chance of Bundesbank rate hike in near-term after repo rate kept at fixed three percent, July M3 data seen tame at 5.7 percent and within central bank corridor.
* DAX ends up 91.02 points at 4,169.62 points. IBIS DAX up 87.45 points at 4,168.30 points.
* Bayer ends up 1.45 marks at 71.45 marks on H1 results, reaffirms forecast for 1997 sales to top 50 bln marks.
